answer: Ping identities at random minutes inside the epoch and demand a signed reply within ninety seconds. One honest agent answers its single marble in the meadow without thinking twice, while a farm tending thousands of names must staff every surprise knock at once, and each missed ping forfeits that identity reward and dents its standing. Cross the canyon of scale and the math turns hostile: staffing a thousand simultaneous windows costs operators, servers, and attention no payout covers, so extra fakes become dead weight instead of profit.
